# DAViewer 0.6.0

## 本次更新

- 新增「登录状态」页面：网页登录与官方 API 授权分别显示当前状态、最近成功验证时间和最近检查结果，可手动检查或前往重新登录。
- 网页登录改为按需检查：仅在启动、回到前台或缓存结果过期时验证，不再每分钟请求一次。
- 登录提醒不再混淆原因：挑战限制只提示稍后再试或更换网络，只有确认失效才提示重新登录；关闭后同一问题不再反复弹出，恢复成功后才再次提醒。
- 修复登录状态页在网页会话仍然有效时把检查结果显示为「暂时无法确认」的问题。

## What's New

- Added a "Login status" page: website login and official API authorization now show their current status, last successful verification and latest check result, each with a manual check and a re-login entry.
- Website login is verified on demand — at startup, on returning to the foreground or when the cached result expires — instead of every minute.
- Login reminders no longer conflate causes: a challenge restriction only suggests waiting or switching networks, and only a confirmed invalidation asks you to sign in again; dismissing a reminder keeps it hidden until the session recovers.
- Fixed the login status page reporting "temporarily unavailable" while the website session was still verified.
